nodes.label: M2: KiriminAja Shipping Module (Origin Malang)
nodes.rationale: Shipping origin is locked to Kota Malang, Jawa Timur (Klojen/Lowokwaru) and accumulates product weightInGrams for transparent multi-courier rates.

nodes.label: M3: User & Admin Account Management (USER/ADMIN)
nodes.rationale: 2-level B2C retail role system (USER and ADMIN) without wholesale/reseller or multi-tenant marketplace features to preserve single-boutique focus.

nodes.norm_label: babyshalls design system v4.0 (fresh minimalist boutique)

nodes.label: Strict Anti-Bias Guardrails
nodes.rationale: Prevent legacy bias and scope creep by enforcing single-store D2C, no heavy AI microservice in Phase 1, fixed Kota Malang logistics origin, Redis graceful fallback, and modular TypeScript components.

nodes.label: Decoupled Modern Monolith / Two-Tier Modular System
nodes.norm_label: decoupled modern monolith / two-tier modular system
nodes.rationale: Separates Next.js 16 SSR storefront from Express API business engine to maximize SEO, isolate Midtrans/KiriminAja transactions, and keep total RAM < 2 GB on Hostinger KVM 1 (4 GB RAM).

nodes.label: BabyShalls Engineering Guardrails (Rules 01-08)
nodes.rationale: Locks scope to single-store Malang boutique, forbids Phase 1 AI microservices, enforces atomic <=250-line components, Decimal currency fields, Redis graceful degradation, and webhook idempotency to ship in 4 weeks.

nodes.label: Redis Cache-Aside Pattern with Graceful Fallback
nodes.norm_label: redis cache-aside pattern with graceful fallback
nodes.rationale: Checks Redis first, falls back to KiriminAja or PostgreSQL on cache miss or unreachable Redis server so checkout flow never crashes.

nodes.label: Midtrans Webhook SHA-512 Verification & CORS Whitelist
nodes.norm_label: midtrans webhook sha-512 verification & cors whitelist
nodes.rationale: Verifies SHA-512(order_id + status_code + gross_amount + ServerKey) before marking orders PAID and restricts backend access via CORS whitelist.

nodes.label: Next.js 16.4+ Frontend Tier (App Router, Turbopack, React 19)
nodes.norm_label: next.js 16.4+ frontend tier (app router, turbopack, react 19)

nodes.label: Product & ProductImage Tables (weight in grams, ageGroup)
nodes.norm_label: product & productimage tables (weight in grams, agegroup)

nodes.label: Redis 7 Caching Strategy (Shipping 60m, Catalog 15m, Idempotency 24h)
nodes.rationale: Caches KiriminAja shipping rates (TTL 60m) to save up to 85% API quota and cut checkout latency from ~800ms to <5ms, caches catalog queries (TTL 15m), and stores Midtrans idempotency keys (TTL 24h).

nodes.label: SHA-256 Request Fingerprinting & Actor Namespacing
nodes.rationale: Detects payload mismatch with the same Idempotency-Key (returning 409 IDEMPOTENCY_KEY_REUSED) and namespaces keys by user:{userId} or ip:{ip} to prevent cross-account response leaks.

nodes.label: Redis Atomic SET NX EX with In-Memory Map Fallback
nodes.norm_label: redis atomic set nx ex with in-memory map fallback
nodes.rationale: Prevents double-order, double Snap token, double event quota deduction, and double book requests on double-click or retry while ensuring the backend never crashes if Redis is offline.

nodes.label: Verified Purchase Review Table (OrderItem 1:1)
nodes.rationale: Product reviews can only be submitted from Order Detail (/account) for verified purchased OrderItems (1:1 relation), never from public product detail forms.

nodes.label: BabyShalls AI Agent Context & Workspace Guide
nodes.norm_label: babyshalls ai agent context & workspace guide

nodes.label: Fresh Minimalist Editorial Boutique & Zero Ornamental Clutter
nodes.norm_label: fresh minimalist editorial boutique & zero ornamental clutter
nodes.rationale: Replaces legacy cream/peach/terracotta tokens and decorative SVG waves/sparkles with a pure white #FFFFFF canvas and product-first visibility inspired by Paulette Kids and Paper Moon Books.

nodes.label: WCAG AA Contrast & 44x44px Touch Targets
nodes.rationale: Ensures #1A1A1A text on #FFFFFF (17.4:1) and #FFD200 (12.6:1) is legible across all ages, with minimum 44x44px mobile touch targets and restrained motion respecting prefers-reduced-motion.

nodes.label: Next.js Breaking Changes Agent Rules
nodes.rationale: This Next.js version has breaking changes relative to training data; agents must read node_modules/next/dist/docs/ before writing code.
